user.title: Device Setup
user.description: Choose which Smart Remote Control entity to create.

target.title: Target
target.description: Select a target entity and provide Learn Device ID

zigbee2mqtt.title: Zigbee2MQTT
zigbee2mqtt.description: Enter the MQTT command topic for the IR transmitter.

localtuya.title: LocalTuya Direct IR
localtuya.description: Select a device already configured in LocalTuya. If discovery is unavailable, enter the LocalTuya Device ID manually.

swing.title: Swing Mode
swing.description: Select supported swing modes. If Swing is not supported, leave this empty and continue.

grouping_attributes.title: Grouping Attributes
grouping_attributes.description: For Home Assistant Remote, attributes selected together form one full-state learned command. Swing or Preset left out of the group is sent as a standalone command.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Optional: select sensors (leave empty if not used)

preset_modes.title: Preset Modes
preset_modes.description: Select supported preset modes. If Preset is not supported, leave this empty and continue.

broadlink.title: Broadlink
broadlink.description: Select the Broadlink remote entity that will transmit the IR codes from the uploaded profile.

profile_review.title: Climate Profile Summary

localtuya_dp.title: LocalTuya IR Send DP
localtuya_dp.description: Select the DP used to send IR commands. Known DPs are listed when LocalTuya exposes them. DP 201 is marked Recommended only when it is present. You can also enter a DP manually.

climate_transmitter.title: Climate Transmitter
climate_transmitter.description: Choose how Climate IR commands will be transmitted.

remote_backend.title: Remote Backend
remote_backend.description: Create a standalone Remote entity that sends IR codes directly.

remote_mqtt.title: MQTT Remote
remote_mqtt.description: Enter the MQTT IR send topic. /set/property sends the IR code directly. /set sends JSON using ir_code_to_send automatically.

remote_localtuya.title: LocalTuya Direct IR Remote
remote_localtuya.description: Select a device already configured in LocalTuya. Discovery is reused from the Climate transmitter.

remote_localtuya_dp.title: LocalTuya IR Send DP
remote_localtuya_dp.description: Select the DP used to send IR codes.

remote_localtuya_prefix.title: LocalTuya Direct IR
remote_localtuya_prefix.description: Optionally require and remove a prefix before sending the IR code. Leave blank to accept the IR code as-is.
